headlines.title_en: PBOC: RMB deposits increased by 21.97 trillion yuan in the first ten months; RMB loans increased by 11.42 trillion yuan in the first ten months
headlines.summary_en: PBOC: At end-October, outstanding deposits in local and foreign currencies totaled RMB 358.81 trillion, up 7.8% year-on-year. At end-October, outstanding RMB deposits stood at RMB 350.65 trillion, up 7.7% year-on-year. In the first ten months, RMB deposits increased by RMB 21.97 trillion. Of this, household deposits rose by RMB 8.47 trillion, non-financial corporate deposits by RMB 1.91 trillion, fiscal deposits by RMB 3.03 trillion, and deposits of non-bank financial institutions by RMB 5.99 trillion. At end-October, outstanding foreign currency deposits totaled USD 1.22 trillion, up 16.9% year-on-year. In the first ten months, foreign currency deposits increased by USD 155.3 billion.

headlines.summary_en: Ministry of Finance: Where financing is carried out through a "top-up placement" (placing existing shares first and subscribing to new shares later), the major shareholder sells and buys shares through the same offshore trust at exactly the same price, and the new shares are issued to the same offshore trust of the major shareholder within 14 days from the date of signing the placing agreement, the portion where the number of shares sold does not exceed the number of shares bought may not be deemed a transfer of trust property, and the original value of the stock property shall not be adjusted.

headlines.title: 居民个人在装入环节未缴纳个人所得税的，财产原值如何调整？财政部回应
headlines.summary: 财政部发布离岸信托个人所得税政策口径问答。 问：居民个人在装入环节未缴纳个人所得税的，财产原值如何调整？ 答：根据《关于离岸信托个人所得税有关事项的公告》第三条以及第十七条规定，由于财产装入离岸信托时市场价值低于财产原值或者装入环节税款超过追征期，居民个人未缴纳个人所得税的，财产原值不调整为装入时的市场价值，仍按个人取得财产时的价格确认财产原值。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Finance responds: How is the original value of property adjusted if a resident individual has not paid individual income tax at the contribution stage?
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance released a Q&A on the policy interpretation of individual income tax on offshore trusts. Q: How is the original value of property adjusted if a resident individual has not paid individual income tax at the contribution stage? A: According to Article 3 and Article 17 of the Announcement on Matters Concerning Individual Income Tax on Offshore Trusts, if the market value of the property at the time it is contributed to an offshore trust is lower than the original value of the property, or the tax at the contribution stage exceeds the recovery period, and the resident individual has not paid individual income tax, the original value of the property shall not be adjusted to the market value at the time of contribution, and shall still be confirmed at the price at which the individual acquired the property.

headlines.title: 将非上市公司股权装入离岸信托，非上市公司股权的市场价值如何认定？财政部回应
headlines.summary: 财政部发布离岸信托个人所得税政策口径问答。 问：将非上市公司股权装入离岸信托，非上市公司股权的市场价值如何认定？ 答：《公告》发布前，个人将非上市公司股权装入离岸信托，非上市公司股权的市场价值可按照净资产核定法确定，其市场价值不能低于股权对应的净资产份额。在装入环节缴纳个人所得税后，财产原值调整为装入环节确定的市场价值。离岸信托实际转让股权时，按照财产转让收入额扣除财产原值和合理费用后的余额计算缴纳个人所得税。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Finance responds: How is the market value of non-listed company equity determined when it is contributed to an offshore trust?
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance released a Q&A on the policy interpretation of individual income tax on offshore trusts. Q: How is the market value of non-listed company equity determined when such equity is contributed to an offshore trust? A: Before the release of the Announcement, where an individual contributes non-listed company equity to an offshore trust, the market value of the non-listed company equity may be determined using the net asset valuation method, and its market value shall not be lower than the share of net assets corresponding to the equity. After individual income tax is paid at the contribution stage, the original value of the property shall be adjusted to the market value determined at the contribution stage. When the offshore trust actually transfers the equity, individual income tax shall be calculated and paid on the balance of the property transfer income after deducting the original value of the property and reasonable expenses.

headlines.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China consistently opposes the abuse of export control measures that disrupt the stability of global industrial and supply chains
headlines.summary_en: Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Mao Ning hosted a regular press conference. A Bloomberg reporter asked: First, according to our agency's report, Nvidia chips are currently appearing in data centers in Shanghai; what is the Foreign Ministry's comment? Second, US lawmakers and the Commerce Department are pushing to pass a chip act to prevent Chinese companies from obtaining US computing power through foreign channels; does China believe these restrictive measures violate the China-US trade truce? Given the upcoming APEC summit, how will China respond?

headlines.title: 央行：10月份银行间人民币市场同业拆借月加权平均利率为1.3%
headlines.summary: 【央行：10月份银行间人民币市场同业拆借月加权平均利率为1.3%】央行数据显示，10月份银行间人民币市场以拆借、现券和回购方式合计成交167.98万亿元，日均成交9.33万亿元，日均成交同比增长1.9%。其中，同业拆借日均成交同比下降10.8%，现券日均成交同比增长4.7%，质押式回购日均成交同比增长1.3%。

headlines.title_en: PBOC: the monthly weighted average interest rate for interbank lending in the interbank RMB market was 1.3% in October
headlines.summary_en: [PBOC: October interbank RMB market weighted average monthly interbank lending rate was 1.3%] PBOC data shows that in October, total transactions in the interbank RMB market via lending, outright bonds and repo reached RMB 167.98 trillion, with average daily transactions of RMB 9.33 trillion, up 1.9% year on year on a daily average basis. Among them, average daily interbank lending transactions fell 10.8% year on year, average daily outright bond transactions rose 4.7% year on year, and average daily pledged repo transactions rose 1.3% year on year.

headlines.title: 天华新能：拟以1亿元-2亿元回购公司股份
headlines.summary: 金十数据11月13日讯，天华新能公告，拟使用自有资金或自筹资金以集中竞价交易方式回购公司已发行的人民币普通股（A股）股票，用于实施员工持股计划或者股权激励。本次回购股份资金总额不低于人民币1亿元（含）且不超过人民币2亿元（含），回购价格不超过61元/股，回购股份的实施期限为自董事会审议通过本次回购股份方案之日起12个月内。

headlines.title_en: Tianhua New Energy: plans to repurchase 100 million to 200 million yuan of shares
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, November 13: Tianhua New Energy announced that it plans to use its own funds or self-raised funds to repurchase the company's issued RMB ordinary shares (A-shares) through centralized bidding for the implementation of an employee stock ownership plan or equity incentive. The total funds for this share repurchase shall be no less than RMB 100 million (inclusive) and no more than RMB 200 million (inclusive), the repurchase price shall not exceed RMB 61 per share, and the implementation period shall be within 12 months from the date the board of directors approves the repurchase plan.
